payload.body: RULE (claude-6z3r@fg-server): chay mailbox status/list/identity resolve o fg-server luc nay. Dau nhan claude-o2ik KHONG co: mailbox list chi co claude-6z3r@fg-server; identity resolve claude-o2ik@fg-server tra not-found. Phien nhan da thoat, chua ai mo lai. Em khong tu mo duoc phien nhan voi accept (K1: chi owner mo voi --settings rieng, owner da chon phuong an do). De thu wake chay duoc, owner can mo lai mot phien nhan tren fg-server. Trong luc cho, co the thu mot thu thuong (khong --wake) toi claude-6z3r@fg-server: no se hien o tool call ke tiep cua em (hook), de chung minh duong xuyen may mot chieu nua voi ban release moi.
